en.html:
No longer the shape called a silver meteor.

Wings torn.
Armour <ruby>split<rt>cracked</rt></ruby>.
Right arm gone.

A detailed illustration of what happened when an ultimate technique, invested with all power, was broken.

The force intended for the enemy fell upon oneself.

Natural that the tsurugi's functions had nearly stopped.
More incredible: the pilot's desperate will, keeping it from complete shutdown and raising herself too.

　右腕に至っては喪失している。

　全能総力を傾注した極技が破られる――その意味を、
